tasks.short: Develop marketing plans and supervise distribution with sales colleagues.

steps.what: Define the finished productions audience, positioning and marketing objectives
inputs: finished production and actual audience evidence

steps.what: Discuss actual sales opportunities, channel needs and distribution responsibilities
outputs: actual marketing and distribution collaboration outcomes

steps.what: Capture checked rights, channels, dates, budgets and agreed sales responsibilities
inputs: actual marketing and distribution collaboration outcomes
existing verified distribution rights and cost records

steps.what: Write the marketing plan using native tables for exact checked facts
Approve the final marketing plan, limitations and internal sales recipients
File the approved final production marketing plan
Send the approved marketing plan to internal sales colleagues
Review actual distribution performance in an existing sales and release status view
inputs: actual dated sales and distribution status records

steps.what: Write and approve actual distribution issues and follow-up decisions
Save the approved actual distribution supervision note

tasks.design: Use native plan templates to insert checked rights, dates and budget tables in {DOCS}, retaining strategy and substantive writing. Use an existing {CRM}/{BI} status view to reduce navigation during actual distribution supervision. Plan filing, internal issue and the later actual supervision-note save each follow approval of their completed artefact; no marketing campaign or distribution deal is automatically launched.
tasks.previous_blocker: A distribution plan does not establish actual channel results or usable rights.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tables and dated sales views can remove repeated factual copying and lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Positioning, channel judgement and sales collaboration require human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Change distribution emphasis when actual audience response conflicts with the original plan.
tasks.altitude: Less plan metadata and status navigation; unchanged marketing and distribution judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document tables and sales dashboards can reuse checked marketing facts and actual distribution status without selecting a strategy.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify actual repeated metadata copying and status navigation; existing native views earn no new saving. No audience or revenue baseline is invented.

Producer creates strategy and collaboration outcomes in s1/s2; existing rights owner and finance supply actual rights/budget records. s3 captures territory, channel, rights_window, release_date, budget and owner at full time. s4 retains 14.4 hours per provisional 100 for substantive writing and corrections; missing rights facts stay manual.

Sales/distribution colleagues produce existing actual production_id, channel, date, status and sales records under their current workflow. s8 retains interpretation and missing-status checks, not runtime saving; no new free reporting is required. s9 separately captures actual issues/actions after review.
a1/a2 bind final s5 plan versions and destinations; a3 binds final s9 actual note. Changes revoke approval. Native templates/views precede code; no implicit external send or spending commitment.
research_questions: Which repeat plan-table and distribution-status actions remain after current native tools are configured?

approvals.approved_version: s5 final marketing plan and project file
s5 final marketing plan and internal sales recipients

steps.what: Develop and verify the production funding need, cash timing and budget evidence
inputs: actual production budget and cash requirements

steps.what: Find relevant existing funder contacts and explicit funding criteria in a native view
inputs: existing funder contact and published criteria records

steps.what: Discuss the production with funders and negotiate provisional financing terms
Prepare the complete final financing agreement from negotiated actual terms
Review and approve the exact final financing agreement for execution and dispatch
Execute the approved final financing agreement through the authorised signature route
Approve the completed signed agreement and final funder dispatch
Send the approved executed financing agreement to the funder
Verify actual funder execution, conditions and funding status
inputs: actual funder execution and funding confirmation

steps.what: Write and approve the actual financing status, conditions and next actions
Commit the approved actual production financing record

tasks.design: Configure a native {CRM} view of existing funder contacts/criteria and the native controlled dispatch in {ESIGN}. Keep funding judgement, negotiation, final terms, approval and actual signature action human. Dispatch follows a fresh review of the completed signed agreement; actual funder execution/funding is checked before a separately approved status commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: An interested funder is not an executed or funded commitment.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing contact views and controlled signature dispatch reduce lookup and document transfer.
tasks.still_hard: Funding suitability, obligations and negotiation remain commercial decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Reject financing terms that undermine the productions ability to deliver or retain necessary rights.
tasks.altitude: Less funder lookup and transfer; unchanged financing authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: contact views and signature systems can support explicit reviewed financing documents without deciding commercial terms.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a producer with existing financing/signature authority. Establish actual manual lookup and dispatch; current native automation earns no new benefit. Above-authority cases retain their actual finance/legal escalation and cannot auto-execute.

Existing finance/contact owners produce funder_id, contact, published criteria and source_date. s2 retains reading/coverage checks; missing criteria use manual research. s1 producer verifies actual budget/cash inputs; no financial baseline is invented.

s3/s4 capture actual amount, currency, schedule, conditions, obligations, rights, repayment and counterparties at full time. s5 approves the complete final terms before a1 covers the separate human signature action; s6b then checks the actual completed signed document and recipient before a2 covers dispatch. Changed terms void both approvals.

Funder supplies actual counter-execution/status; s8 checks actual conditions and money status rather than assuming receipt. s9 separately records/checks actual state before a3. Native features precede code; no bank transfer or additional financing decision is executed.
research_questions: Which funder lookup and agreement-transfer steps remain manual within the current authorised financing route?

tasks.short: Hire principal cast and production crew.

steps.what: Define actual production roles, required experience, dates and approved compensation bounds
inputs: actual production requirements and approved staffing budget
outputs: producer-defined cast and crew role requirements

steps.what: Interview candidates and review actual portfolios, audition evidence and relevant references
inputs: producer-defined cast and crew role requirements
actual candidate portfolios, audition evidence and references
outputs: human cast and crew candidate assessment

steps.what: Choose the principal cast members and crew members to hire
inputs: human cast and crew candidate assessment
producer-defined cast and crew role requirements
outputs: human cast or crew hiring choice

steps.what: Discuss and negotiate provisional role, compensation, dates and working arrangements
inputs: human cast or crew hiring choice

steps.what: Prepare the complete offer using exact negotiated fields and approved contract clauses
outputs: complete candidate cast or crew offer

steps.what: Approve the exact final offer, authority and intended candidate recipient
inputs: complete candidate cast or crew offer
outputs: approved final cast or crew offer

steps.what: Send the approved final cast or crew offer to the selected candidate
inputs: approved final cast or crew offer
outputs: sent final cast or crew offer

steps.what: Verify the actual candidate acceptance and resolve changed or outstanding terms
inputs: sent final cast or crew offer
actual candidate acceptance or requested changes
outputs: verified actual cast or crew hiring status

steps.what: Write and approve the actual hiring status and source acceptance reference
inputs: verified actual cast or crew hiring status
outputs: approved actual cast or crew hiring record

steps.what: Commit the approved actual cast or crew hiring record
inputs: approved actual cast or crew hiring record
outputs: filed actual cast or crew hiring record

tasks.design: Use native {CLM} offer templates for exact negotiated terms and selected approved clauses. Keep candidate evaluation, hiring choice and negotiation human; no model ranks or selects people. Send the complete approved offer separately, verify actual acceptance, then separately write/approve/commit actual status in {HCM}; an issued offer is not an accepted hire.
tasks.previous_blocker: A standard offer does not establish a suitable performer or workable employment terms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contract templates can reduce repeated copying of negotiated fields.
tasks.still_hard: Creative fit, references, compensation and responsibilities require human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a collaborator who can deliver the production role and agree fair workable expectations.
tasks.altitude: Less offer transcription; unchanged hiring rights and assessment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: contract templates can insert explicit negotiated role/date/pay fields without evaluating candidates or deciding terms.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a producer with existing hiring authority. Observe actual offer copying/send/record work; current native functionality earns no new benefit.

Producer produces role requirements and actual evaluations in s1/s2. This step reviews existing audition evidence; holding the audition is the adjacent task, so the same live audition labour must not be duplicated in roll-up.

Producer/candidate produce actual provisional terms in s4. Retained s5 time captures/checks person_id, role, dates, location, compensation, currency, rights/working terms and chosen clause versions, with substantive exceptions remaining manual. No machine invents compensation or clause applicability.

s6 checks the completed offer and authority before a1. s8 actual candidate acceptance is a new source; changed terms require a revised complete offer/approval, not an automatic acceptance. s9 captures/checks actual status and source reference before a2. Native templates precede code; no separate signature, payroll or access activation is silently performed.
research_questions: Which exact negotiated offer fields are still copied manually after native contract templates are used?

steps.what: Collect and check performer availability, role requirements, audition duration and room constraints
Prepare compatible audition slots and exact-field invitation drafts
Approve complete audition slots, instructions, recipients and calendar destination
outputs: approved final audition invitations and slots

steps.what: Commit approved exact audition slots to the calendar
inputs: approved final audition invitations and slots

steps.what: Send the approved final audition invitations to performers
inputs: approved final audition invitations and slots
outputs: issued audition invitations and booked slots

steps.what: Conduct auditions and direct performers through the actual material

issued audition invitations and booked slots

steps.what: Evaluate each actual performance against the parts artistic and practical requirements

tasks.design: Use native scheduling constraints and invitation templates in {CALENDAR}/{DOCS} after full human availability capture. Keep audition direction, artistic judgement and substantive observation writing human. Approve completed slots/invitations before separate calendar commit and external invitation send, then separately approve the actual audition record before its save; no model ranks performers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability matching does not determine whether a performer is right for the part.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calendar constraints can match explicit responses and produce checked invitations.
tasks.still_hard: Artistic range, response to direction and role fit require actual auditions.
tasks.human_edge: See how a performer changes a scene after direction rather than rely on a profile score.
tasks.altitude: Less audition scheduling with unchanged artistic evaluation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: calendar tools can match explicitly supplied availability and generate exact-field audition invitations without evaluating performers.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for the audition branch of the statements audition-or-contract task. Observe actual scheduling and save work; existing native functions earn no new benefit. Actor contract negotiation remains the actual separate hiring/contract route, not hidden automated work in this branch.

Performers produce actual availability responses; venue owner supplies existing room availability. s1 producer captures/checks performer_id, role, available_windows, duration, room, access needs and instruction references at full time. Missing responses use manual coordination; no free self-service inputs.

s3 approves complete instructions, slots and recipients. s5/s6 retain full auditions and artistic assessment; s7 captures actual performer, material, observations, interpretation and follow-up at full time before a2. Planned attendance is not an observed performance.

Native calendar/templates precede code; invitation changes require renewed approval. This produces audition evidence for later hiring and must not duplicate the same live audition in the hiring task roll-up.
